Composite Shingle Roof Cost Guide (2026)

Direct Pricing Summary (2026): Composite Shingle Roof Cost Guide (2026) typically ranges between $950 – $1,600 per square installed for complete installation, averaging $19,000 – $33,000 for a standard 2,000 sq ft home.

How Much Does a Composite Shingle Roof Cost in 2026?

Investing in a composite shingle roof represents a significant long-term enhancement to your home's structural protection and exterior curb appeal. Nationwide, professional installation typically averages $950 – $1,600 per square installed, resulting in a total project investment of approximately $19,000 – $33,000 for a standard 2,000 square foot residential home.

What Is Included in a Professional Written Proposal?

When reviewing written bids from certified independent contractors in our referral network, verify that your proposal accounts for the complete roofing system:

  • Complete Tear-Off & Disposal: Stripping old shingles down to the sheathing and hauling debris to licensed recycling or disposal facilities.
  • Substrate Decking Inspection: Checking every square foot of plywood or OSB roof decking for water staining, mold, or structural deflection.
  • Waterproofing Barrier: Self-adhering ice-and-water shield along eaves, valleys, and around roof penetrations.
  • Synthetic Underlayment: Commercial-grade tear-resistant breathable synthetic underlayment.
  • Flashing Packages: Step flashing, counter flashing, kickout diverters, and pre-formed metal drip edges along all eaves and rakes.
  • Continuous Ridge Ventilation: Balanced intake and exhaust vents to protect manufacturer warranties.

Good, Better, Best Pricing Tiers

Material grades and warranty tiers determine total investment for this roofing system:

Tier Level Grade Name Installed Cost Per Square Application & Durability Profile
Good Single-Width Composite Slate $950 – $1,180/sq Uniform width synthetic tiles with authentic stone beveling.
Better Multi-Width Composite Slate / Shake $1,180 – $1,420/sq Varied widths and blended color shades for high natural realism.
Best Select Hand-Split Composite Shake $1,420 – $1,700/sq Heavy-butt synthetic shakes with Class A fire rating and lifetime warranty.

Key Factors That Drive Your Roofing Bid

  • Single-width vs multi-width randomized bundles
  • Class A vs Class C fire-retardant underlayment system
  • Hip and ridge cap tile packages
  • Savings from avoiding structural rafter reinforcement (unlike real slate)
